name: Tandoori Oven (Logan, UT) Tandoori Chicken Tikka Skewers (Dairy-Free / Mild)
whyItWorks: Clay oven roasting seals in moisture while letting excess fat drip away. Lean chicken breast with aromatic spices like turmeric is extraordinarily digestible and gut-friendly.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Chicken Tikka skewers with plain basmati rice; request no spicy mint chutney and no raw onion rings.
watchOuts: None when eaten with plain rice and no spicy chutney
